record.paper_title: 20 Open Questions About Deformations of Compactifiable Manifolds
record.context_brief: Affine-bundle structures in deformations of W_k
record.original_question: Consider a compactifiable or projectivizable deformation (Xcal, D, Y, f, o, j) of X = W_k, where W_k = Tot(O_P1(-k) ⊕ O_P1(k - 2)). For which parameters t in Y does the fiber f^{-1}(t) admit a surjection to P1 extending the structure of X ∩ f^{-1}(t) as an affine bundle over P1? For which t is the fiber f^{-1}(t) at least covered by projective subspaces of codimension 1?

evidence.quote: Question 11. Consider a compactifiable (or projectivizable) deformation (X , D, Y, f, o, j) of X = Wk. For which t ∈ Y is there a surjection f^{-1}(t) −→ P1 extending the structure of X ∩ f^{-1}(t) as an affine bundle over P1? For which t ∈ Y is f^{-1}(t) at least covered by codimension 1 projective spaces?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k \geq 1$ be an integer and let
$$X = W_k := \mathrm{Tot}\bigl(\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-k) \oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(k-2)\bigr)$$
denote the total space of the rank-2 holomorphic vector bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-k) \oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(k-2)$ on $\mathbb{P}^1$. The natural projection $X \to \mathbb{P}^1$ endows $X$ with the structure of a rank-2 affine bundle over $\mathbb{P}^1$.

By a compactifiable (resp. projectivizable) deformation of $X$ we mean a tuple $(\mathcal{X}, D, Y, f, o, j)$ where:
\begin{itemize}
  \item $\mathcal{X}$ is a complex manifold (resp. smooth complex projective variety),
  \item $D \subset \mathcal{X}$ is a smooth divisor (the boundary at infinity), set $\mathcal{X}^\circ := \mathcal{X} \setminus D$,
  \item $Y$ is a complex manifold (resp. variety) with a distinguished base point $o \in Y$,
  \item $f : \mathcal{X} \to Y$ is a proper holomorphic submersion (resp. smooth projective morphism) such that $f|_D : D \to Y$ is also a submersion,
  \item $j : X \hookrightarrow \mathcal{X}^\circ$ is a biholomorphism onto the central fiber $\mathcal{X}^\circ_o = f^{-1}(o) \setminus D$.
\end{itemize}
For $t \in Y$, write $\mathcal{X}_t := f^{-1}(t)$ and $\mathcal{X}^\circ_t := \mathcal{X}_t \setminus D$.

Determine, in terms of the deformation data:
\begin{enumerate}
  \item[(a)] the locus of $t \in Y$ for which there exists a surjective morphism $\mathcal{X}_t \twoheadrightarrow \mathbb{P}^1$ whose restriction to $\mathcal{X}^\circ_t$ extends the affine bundle structure $X \to \mathbb{P}^1$ inherited via $j$ at $t = o$;
  \item[(b)] the (possibly larger) locus of $t \in Y$ for which $\mathcal{X}_t$ is covered by codimension-1 projective subspaces (i.e. through every point of $\mathcal{X}_t$ passes a closed subvariety isomorphic to $\mathbb{P}^{\dim \mathcal{X}_t - 1}$).
\end{enumerate}
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as one of twenty open problems on deformations of compactifiable manifolds (2020). Web searches return the original problem list but no follow-up work resolving the specific question about which fibers in a compactifiable deformation of $W_k$ admit a surjection to $\mathbb{P}^1$ extending the affine bundle structure, or are covered by codimension-1 projective subspaces. No solution appears to be available.
